title: kithctl backup
description:
Implement kithctl backup: if dest path given, use SQLite online backup API to copy live DB; if no dest, print recommended copy command with advisory.

WHAT: Let operators safely back up the live mailbox database without stopping kithd.

ALGORITHM:
1. Build Config; derive db_path = config.db_path()
2. Check if dest argument was provided (Option<PathBuf>)
3. If dest is Some(dest_path):
   a. Verify db_path exists: if not, eprintln! and exit(1)
   b. If dest_path exists already: eprintln!("error: dest {dest_path:?} already exists; remove it first to avoid overwriting") and exit(1)
   c. Open src with rusqlite::Connection::open_with_flags(&db_path, OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY | OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_NO_MUTEX)?
   d. Open dst with rusqlite::Connection::open(&dest_path)? (creates new file)
   e. Set dest permissions to 0o600 immediately after creation using std::fs::set_permissions
   f. Create backup = rusqlite::backup::Backup::new(&src, &mut dst)?
   g. Call backup.run_to_completion(100, Duration::from_millis(250), Some(|p: Progress| { eprint!("\rBacking up... {}/{} pages", p.pagecount - p.remaining, p.pagecount); }))?
   h. eprintln!() (newline after progress)
   i. println!("Backup complete: {}", dest_path.display())
   j. println!("Note: also backup attachments at {}/attachments if present", config.data_dir.display())
4. If dest is None:
   a. println!("# Live backup (safe while kithd is running):")
   b. println!("kithctl backup --dest {}.backup", db_path.display())
   c. println!()
   d. println!("# Or stop kithd first, then copy the whole data directory:")
   e. println!("cp -a {} {}.backup", config.data_dir.display(), config.data_dir.display())
   f. println!("# (includes database, TLS certs, and attachments)")

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- Refuse to overwrite an existing dest file without explicit flag (future --force flag)
- Set dest file mode 0o600 immediately after open — before any data written
- use rusqlite::backup::Backup not Connection::backup() convenience method (need progress cb)
- Handle Busy/Locked StepResult: run_to_completion retries internally; if it returns Err, report and exit(1)
- Never log the database contents, only progress page counts
- Import: use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt for set_permissions

TESTS:
- Integration test: create a temp SQLite DB with one row, call backup logic with a temp dest path, verify dest exists, is valid SQLite, and contains the same row. Oracle: open dest with rusqlite::Connection::open() and query the same row.
- Test: dest already exists → error message and exit code check
